scope: whole design package: all leaves, APIs, contracts, ownership, roots and end-to-end seams
method: source-grounded reasoning plus whole-manifest/card structural traversal; not runtime verification or an independent reviewer
findings: 全包重走API→source→kernel→channel→cut→sink→history后，修正source read frontier与未发预取的区别，pending_refs必须随恢复保存。
补具体Local/Ray控制传输及统一HostedDataflowWorker，不把HostEndpoint Protocol当已有实现。
发现远程reserve先写payload_ref会循环依赖配额；冻结小命令inline、ControlReply和artifact allowlist，worker不能直写journal。
消除版本loader递归和plan_view隐式I/O；核验现有K3 assignment逐字段映射，不改冻结协议；后续还须补完整验收矩阵。
